values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov up to 6 months ahead (group sites 12 months); the Forest Service page says reservations must be made 2 days before arrival, while recreation.gov's own rule lists no cutoff. Friday and Saturday must be booked together; holiday weekends take 3 nights. Recreation.gov notice: 'The Family Campground has first-come, first-served sites.' $10 cancellation fee.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/morris-hill-campground ('Reservations must be made 2 days ahead of arrival and can be made up to 6 months in advance for standard sites'; 'You may stay up to 14 nights'; 'Two Night Weekend Minimum'; 'Three Night Holiday Weekend Minimum'; '$10 cancellation fee') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232161 (notice 'The Family Campground has first-come, first-served sites.'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Memorial Day weekend to late October.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/morris-hill-campground ('Seasons of Use: Memorial Day Weekend - late-October'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: $18 a night for standard and tent sites on recreation.gov's rate table (2026 and 2027 seasons); group sites $65. The Forest Service page instead says '$21 per night for standard sites'.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232161/rates (Peak Season 2026-09-09 to 2026-10-28 and 2027: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 18, GROUP TENT ONLY AREA 65) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/morris-hill-campground ('Fees are $21 per night for standard sites and $65 per night for group sites.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 51 standard non-electric RV sites plus 2 tent-only sites and 2 group tent areas; 'Most sites will fit any size RV'. Catalog lengths run 20-40 ft (19 sites at 23 ft, 21 at 30 ft or more); one pull-through, the rest back-in.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232161 (RIDB, trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232161 ('Family Campground: Most sites will fit any size RV.'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232161 ('Campsite amenities include flush toilets, hot showers, a playground and drinking water.'), read 2026-10-21

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/morris-hill-campground ('The America the Beautiful Senior and Access Passes provide a 50% discount to the base campsite fee (not hook ups) and day use fees.'), read 2026-10-21

note: USFS (Warm Springs/James River district) on a wooded ridge above the south end of Lake Moomaw near Covington; ~0.5 mi from the lakeshore (not on the water - swim beach, fishing pier and boat ramp are a short drive away). --Claude
summary: Read the Forest Service page and recreation.gov: confirmed reservable on recreation.gov 6 months out, added some first-come sites, weekend 2 / holiday 3 night minimums, 14-night max, season Memorial Day weekend-late October, 51 RV sites to 40 ft (one pull-through), flush toilets/showers/water, senior-pass discount; kept $18 (rec.gov rate table) with the FS page's $21 in fees.note. Dropped 'reservable online' from the note.
flags: Phone missing: recreation.gov lists the campground at 540-279-4144; the managing James River and Warm Springs Ranger District office is 540-839-2521 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/morris-hill-campground).

Fee conflict between official pages: recreation.gov's rate table charges $18 for standard sites (2026-2027 seasons) while the Forest Service page says '$21 per night for standard sites'. Recorded $18, the price the booking site charges.
